principle: Expand only from reviewed GOLDEN_APPROVED TRAIN parents; derived tasks are candidates, not automatically trusted training data.

mode_objectives.IMPLEMENT_VARIANT: Re-implement the same contract from requirements and constraints without copying the reference solution verbatim.
mode_objectives.REPAIR_BUG: Diagnose and repair a deterministic defect while preserving the original contract.
mode_objectives.WRITE_TESTS: Design focused tests for normal, boundary and failure behavior without seeing HOLDOUT tasks.
mode_objectives.CODE_REVIEW: Review a defective implementation against contract, complexity and maintainability requirements and propose corrections.
mode_objectives.EDGE_CASE_ANALYSIS: Identify boundary conditions, invariants and failure modes and map them to concrete tests.

next_gate.name: MIN_DERIVED_CANDIDATE_REVIEW
required_checks: all 40 derived task ids are unique
8 tasks exist for each derivation mode
no HOLDOUT task id or implementation is present
repair/review mutations are deterministic and syntactically valid where code is supplied

telemetry_rule: Do not count derived candidates as training examples until their own review gate passes. Do not claim model improvement, speedup or ETA from corpus generation alone.
